description: This file defines the interface for the WiFi EndPoint Profile class, including its data members, methods for retrieving profile attributes, and documentation for TR-069 related APIs.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile
classes.description: Class providing access to WiFi EndPoint Profile attributes and related operations, including singleton management and profile property getters.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves whether the WiFi EndPoint Profile is enabled.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the WiFi EndPoint Profile (Active, Available, Error, Disabled).

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias name of the WiFi EndPoint Profile.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_SSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID associated with the profile.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Location
methods.description: Retrieves the location description of the profile.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Priority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of the profile used for access point selection.
